LAHSA training tools

Everything built for the HMIS Basic Navigation series — the tools that author it and the blocks that ship. Every page here is self-contained and fetches nothing.

Authoring tools

Open in a browser. Nothing is installed and nothing you write leaves the machine.

  • Knowledge check maker

    Two kinds — the scored card check (a deck, one right answer, a pass mark) and the Copperfield (one box, no right answer, the answers disintegrate as you take them). Rich text, three themes for the check, exports a Rise-ready zip.

    Rebuild: python3 tools/kc-maker/make_maker.py

  • Scene editor

    The photos-and-narration openers. Ken Burns motion over stills against the audio clock, keyframes per scene. Exports one self-contained page that fetches nothing.

    Rebuild: no build — the tool is the source

  • Job aid builder

    Printable step-by-step guides. Steps and substeps, a screenshot per step with a choice of frame and border, page breaks, a table of contents, your own logo. Download PDF; projects save and reopen. jsPDF is vendored in, not fetched.

    Rebuild: no build — the tool is the source

  • Lashes block builder

    A Lashes message block for Rise — her, a line and a button. Four expressions, either side of the message, plus a Launcher shape. Downloads an index.html or copies the code out.

    Rebuild: no build — the tool is the source

Lesson 2 — Search · Rise blocks

Each zip holds an index.html, which is what a Rise Code block looks for.

  • Simulation 1 — Finding a Participant

    Eight scored situations, with the orientation tour. Launches full screen from a Begin card.

    Rebuild: python3 'HMIS BNTS - Search/launcher/make_launcher.py'

  • Simulation 2 — Verifying a Record

    Five scored situations on telling near-identical records apart.

    Rebuild: python3 'HMIS BNTS - Search/launcher/make_launcher.py'

  • Task embed 1

    Searches Desmond Carrow, then Carrow alone, and finds nobody. Interface only.

    Rebuild: cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && ./build.sh

  • Task embed 2

    Searches the fragment Dez with the year 1974 and lands on two records.

    Rebuild: cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && ./build.sh

  • Task embed 3

    Settles which Dezmond it is, by Location or by the Point of Contact.

    Rebuild: cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && ./build.sh

  • Free-play search

    Search and results only. They can type anything; there is no way into a record.

    Rebuild: cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && ./build.sh

  • Knowledge check

    Six questions, five to pass. Completion is withheld until the mark is cleared.

    Rebuild: cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && ./build.sh

Build and check

Run from the repository root.

  • Build the lesson

    Regenerates the roster, then every page and zip. --scorm also writes the SCORM packages, which are off by default.

    cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && ./build.sh
  • Run the lesson tests

    The whole contract: search behaviour, the fictional-data promises, the embeds, the knowledge check, and that nothing fetches anything.

    cd 'HMIS BNTS - Search' && node test.mjs
  • Run the maker tests

    Drives the editor, then plays every theme’s export in a frame.

    cd tools/kc-maker && node test.mjs
  • Check the build against the script

    Fails if any learner-facing block differs in wording, in either direction. Needs the current script docx.

    SCRIPT_DOCX='…' node 'HMIS BNTS - Search/script/check_copy.mjs'
  • Check no task gives itself away

    Runs the naive search for every task and fails if the first thing a trainee would type hands over the answer.

    node 'HMIS BNTS - Search/tools/obviousness.mjs'
  • Rebuild this page python3 tools/make_index.py
